title: The Chained Pilgrims
text: Pilgrims walk the road chained together at the ankle, as penance, singing through split lips. The chain has worn their skin to the bone. At the end of the line a young one stumbles, catches your eye, and begs to be freed.

options.label: Free the one who begged, whatever the others think of her penance.

outcomes.text: The others curse you for stealing her penance. She weeps her thanks and runs, and does not look back.

options.label: Leave them to their penance. Their pain is their own to choose.

outcomes.text: They walk on, and the one who begged spits at the Leader's feet. The rest bless you for leaving them their pain, a cold, hard blessing.

options.label: The strongest breaks every chain, so that none of them need suffer.

outcomes.text: Freed, all of them, and furious, and they turn on you for taking their penance away.
